```yaml
name: SBOM Generation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'package.json'
      - 'package-lock.json'
      - 'yarn.lock'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - '.github/workflows/sbom.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'package.json'
      - 'package-lock.json'
      - 'yarn.lock'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - '.github/workflows/sbom.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  generate-sbom:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Generate CycloneDX SBOM
        run: npx @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm --output-file sbom.json --output-format json

      - name: Upload SBOM artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: sbom-cyclonedx
          path: sbom.json
          retention-days: 90
```
